_comment: goal —— 3 英文边界 / 4 现有中文义项。足球语境的两条边界（球门 / 进球得分）都是真实且常用的区分；「终点」在英语里也是 goal 的合法义项（赛跑终点），走 fromZh。

_oldSenses.reason: 对应英文 raw=0 the state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and toward which it is intended to move。
英文 goal 也指赛跑的终点（the goal line / cross the finish line）。WordNet 无此边界，走 fromZh 补洞。
对应英文 raw=2 a successful attempt at scoring —— 进球得分。
对应英文 raw=1 game equipment consisting of the place toward which players attempt to move the ball。

senses.note: the state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve。**最常用义**。线索：achieve / set a goal / a long-term goal。
game equipment consisting of the place toward which players attempt to move the ball。指**装备/位置**。线索：in the goal / a goal kick。
a successful attempt at scoring。指**动作/结果**。线索：score / concede a goal。与 s2 分界：s2 是「球门这个位置」，s3 是「踢进去这一下」。
英文 goal 指赛跑终点。走 fromZh 补洞，glossEn 留空。线索：the goal line / a photo finish at the goal。
